previousEditions.title: Where EUROXPRO has been
previousEditions.intro: Each year a different country hosts. Here is what we know about the last three.
previousEditions.disclaimer: Figures and themes come from publicly shared information about past editions. They describe those conferences only and are not targets or confirmed numbers for EUROXPRO'27.

items.summary: More than 500 young leaders and at least six partner organisations met in Greece under the theme 'United in Exchanges', with a focus on cross-border mobility.
Over 380 delegates from 50+ countries met on the Adriatic coast in Rimini. Sessions covered keeping organisations healthy, leading across cultures and aligning national committees.
About 300 participants came to Alanya, just along the coast from Antalya, to work on local committee growth, membership and regional cooperation.

hero.title: Questions
hero.intro: Short answers about travel, hotel, visa and the congress.

items.title: Antalya Airport (AYT)
items.text: Fly to **Antalya Airport (AYT)**. We meet you at arrivals on **31 March**.

items.title: Hotel
items.text: Everyone stays at the **congress hotel**. Details coming soon.

items.title: Visa
items.text: Some passports need an **e-Visa**. It only takes a few minutes online.

items.question: How do I register for EUROXPRO'27?
items.answer: We will share the sign-up link here and on social media soon.

items.question: What is the registration fee?
items.answer: Not announced yet. It will come with registration.

items.question: Is there a deadline for registration?
items.answer: Dates come with registration. Places are limited, so sign up early.

items.question: Can I cancel or transfer my registration?
items.answer: The rules come with registration. Questions? Email contact@euroxpro27.com.

items.question: Do I need a visa to enter Türkiye?
items.answer: It depends on your passport. Check evisa.gov.tr. Many people can get an e-Visa online in minutes.

items.question: How do I get from Antalya Airport (AYT) to the hotel?
items.answer: We meet you at the airport on 31 March and take you to the hotel. Trams, buses and taxis are there too.

items.question: Which airport should I fly into?
items.answer: Antalya Airport (AYT). Many direct flights, or change in Istanbul.

items.question: What documents do I need to bring?
items.answer: Passport (valid 6+ months), visa if needed, registration confirmation and travel insurance.

items.question: Where will delegates be staying in Antalya?
items.answer: At the congress hotel. We will share the name soon.

items.question: Is accommodation included in the registration fee?
items.answer: We will tell you before registration opens.

items.question: Can I arrange my own accommodation?
items.answer: We recommend the congress hotel. Special needs? Write to us.

items.question: How do I get around Antalya?
items.answer: Tram, buses and taxis. Pay with an AntalyaKart or a contactless card.

items.question: What is an AntalyaKart?
items.answer: Antalya's travel card for trams and buses. A bank card works too.

items.question: Will there be transfers between the hotel and venue?
items.answer: Yes, we arrange all group transfers.

items.question: What currency is used in Türkiye?
items.answer: Turkish Lira (₺). Cards work almost everywhere.

items.question: Can I pay by card in Antalya?
items.answer: Yes, Visa and Mastercard. Tell your bank you are travelling.

items.question: Where can I exchange currency?
items.answer: Exchange offices (Döviz) and bank ATMs are everywhere.

items.question: What are the confirmed congress dates?
items.answer: 31 March – 4 April 2027, in Antalya.

items.question: When will the full agenda be published?
items.answer: Soon. We will post it on the Congress page and in News.

items.question: When will the merch collection be available?
items.answer: It is still being made. You can tell us what you like on the Merch page.

items.question: Can I order merch before the congress?
items.answer: Not yet. Nothing is charged right now.

items.question: Will merch be available at the congress?
items.answer: Yes, some items will be there.

items.question: Are meals included?
items.answer: We will tell you when registration opens.

items.question: How do I communicate dietary restrictions?
items.answer: Tell us during registration: allergies, halal, vegetarian, vegan or gluten-free.

items.question: Is food halal in Antalya?
items.answer: Yes, halal is standard in Türkiye. Vegetarian and vegan food is easy to find.

items.question: What is the emergency number in Türkiye?
items.answer: 112, free and 24/7. English is spoken.

items.question: Is Antalya safe for international visitors?
items.answer: Yes, very. Millions of visitors come every year, and we are there to help.

items.question: Who do I contact if I have an emergency during the congress?
items.answer: Call 112. We will also give you our 24/7 phone number at check-in.

items.question: Should I get travel insurance?
items.answer: Yes, we strongly recommend it.

items.question: How do I contact the Organizing Committee?
items.answer: Use the Contact page or email contact@euroxpro27.com. We reply within 2–3 days.

items.question: I didn't find my answer here. What should I do?
items.answer: Write to us on the Contact page. We are happy to help.
